text.en: Segment anything is row 101 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Detection Segmentation area.
text.zh: Segment anything 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 101 行，所属领域为“检测与分割”。

text.en: The annual table associates Segment anything with “Segment anything”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Segment anything 与论文《Segment anything》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Alexander Kirillov, Eric Mintun, Nikhila Ravi, Hanzi Mao, Piotr Dollar, Ross Girshick”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 亚历山大·基里洛夫、埃里克·明顿、尼基拉·拉维、汉兹·毛、彼得·多拉尔、罗斯·格希克；官方英文原文为“Alexander Kirillov, Eric Mintun, Nikhila Ravi, Hanzi Mao, Piotr Dollar, Ross Girshick”。

text.en: SAM accepts points, boxes or masks as prompts and returns segmentation masks through a promptable interface.
text.zh: SAM 接收点、框或掩码提示，并通过可提示接口返回分割掩码。

text.en: SA-1B contains more than one billion masks from roughly eleven million images collected with a model-assisted data engine.
text.zh: SA-1B 通过模型辅助数据引擎，从约 1100 万张图像中收集超过 10 亿个掩码。
